CS3103 requires CS2105 or EE3204 or EE3204E or EE4204. Student has NOT completed CS2105, EE3204, EE3204E, or EE4204. CS2105 requires CS2040 or CS2040S or CS2040C or CS2040DE or CS2040HS or YSC2229. Student has CS2040S. So CS2105 is eligible. CS2105 is offered Sem 1 and Sem 2. CS3103 is offered Sem 1. So CS2105 must be taken in Sem 5 or 6 to allow CS3103 in Sem 7? No, CS3103 is Sem 1 only. Sem 5 is Sem 1 of Y3S1. Sem 7 is Sem 1 of Y4S1. So CS2105 can be in Sem 5, 6, 7? No, CS3103 is Sem 1. If CS2105 is in Sem 6 (Sem 2), CS3103 cannot be in Sem 7 (Sem 1) because CS2105 is not completed *before* Sem 7? Prerequisites must be completed or planned in a STRICTLY earlier semester. So if CS2105 is in Sem 6, CS3103 can be in Sem 7. Yes. CS2102 requires CS1231S (completed) and (CS2030S or ...). Student has CS2030S. So CS2102 is eligible. CS2102 is offered Sem 1 and Sem 2. CS3240 requires CS2111 or NM2207. Student has NOT completed CS2111 or NM2207. CS2111 requires CS1010A or ... or CS1101S. Student has CS1101S. So CS2111 is eligible. CS2111 is offered Sem 2. NM2207 is offered Sem 2. So CS3240 requires CS2111 or NM2207, both offered Sem 2. CS3240 is offered Sem 1. This is a conflict. CS3240 is offered Sem 1. Its prerequisite is CS2111 or NM2207. CS2111 is offered Sem 2. NM2207 is offered Sem 2. Therefore, CS2111 and NM2207 can only be taken in Sem 2 (even semesters). CS3240 can only be taken in Sem 1 (odd semesters). To take CS3240 in Sem N (odd), the prerequisite must be completed in a strictly earlier semester. The earliest Sem 2 is Sem 2, 4, 6, 8. The earliest Sem 1 after Sem 2 is Sem 3. So CS3240 can be taken in Sem 3, 5, 7. The student is in Sem 5. So CS3240 can be taken in Sem 5 or 7. If CS3240 is in Sem 5, CS2111/NM2207 must be in Sem 3 or 4. The student is in Sem 5 now. So CS2111/NM2207 must have been taken in Sem 3 or 4. The student has not completed them. So CS3240 CANNOT be taken in Sem 5 because the prerequisite is not completed. Can it be taken in Sem 7? Prerequisite must be in Sem 5 or 6. CS2111/NM2207 are Sem 2 only. So they can be in Sem 6. Then CS3240 can be in Sem 7. So CS3240 must be in Sem 7. But CS3268 is also in Sem 7. CS3240 and CS3268 are mutually exclusive? No. CS3240 is mutually exclusive with nothing listed? Wait, CS3240 record: "mutually exclusive with: none" (implied, not listed). But CS3240 and CS3268 are both 4 MC. Limit is 4 MC per semester. So they cannot be in the same semester. CS3240 must be in Sem 7. CS3268 must be in Sem 7. This is a conflict. Therefore, no plan exists.", "reasons": ["CS3240 is offered only in Sem 1. Its prerequisites (CS2111 or NM2207) are offered only in Sem 2. Thus, CS3240 can only be taken in Sem 3, 5, or 7, provided the prerequisite is taken in the preceding Sem 2. Since the student is in Sem 5 and has not completed CS2111 or NM2207, CS3240 can only be taken in Sem 7 (with prerequisite in Sem 6).", "CS3268 is required in Sem 7 (Y4S1). CS3240 is also forced into Sem 7 due to prerequisite timing. Both are 4 MC courses, but the student's limit is 4 MC per semester. They cannot be taken together.", "No other semester allows CS3240 because Sem 5 is too early (prereq not done) and Sem 3/4 are past. Sem 9 does not exist."]}
